name: mac-local-sqlite
about: The same work on the person's own Mac: no per-row, per-request or storage charge (C65). Every price is a literal 0: no provider bills the person's own Mac, and the local-mac-only price sheet lists each of its meters at 0. Literal prices also keep this model loadable with no pricing root, which the candidate tests rely on.

prices.basis: No per-row price on the person's own Mac (local-mac-only.json has no row meter).
No per-row price on the person's own Mac.
No per-row price on the person's own Mac.
Local calls are not billed (local-mac-only.json lists requests at 0).

storage.basis: Disk is finite (C66) but not billed per GB-month (local-mac-only.json lists storage at 0).

latency.basis: AI assumption; measured local wall time per operation is in wall-clock.json.

unpriced.item: CPU energy, battery, disk wear, home network

unpriced.why: the Mac placement starts no alarms (BI:186)
